title: Web app uses the cloud backend and bucket in production
description: The deployed web app reads amplify_outputs.json from the deployment (AppSync API + Storage bucket, Cognito auth instead of the local API key), fetches audio and metadata from the bucket via the same library-relative keys as local /files/, and the hero plays from the synced assets. Coordinate any web/src/ui change through this issue (the web session owns visuals). Depends on apricitus-25e216 (S3 Files + sync) and apricitus-9bd3ef (hero rewrite).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Hero part done (bootstrap() called at startup; guest read on files/hero/*). STILL OPEN: Library and Score screens still call the local Python server (/api/samples, /api/scores, /api/score, /api/annotations, /api/upload in web/src/apricity.ts) and 404 on the deployed site; they need the cloud data layer + sign-in.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Library/Score screens: web/src/apricity.ts api layer (samples, scores, score, saveScore, annotations, upload) is still the Python server's /api/*; port it onto data/domain.ts + storage after sign-in and the loader exist. Until then the deployed Library and Score tabs 404 in the console.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Library/Score port done (uncommitted, for review): new web/src/data/catalog.ts (records+attachments -> SampleSummary/Manifest, paging, SignedOut), apricity.ts api/manifest/audioUrl on it, library.ts/score.ts empty states + apricity:auth-changed reload, player.ts and flow/peaks.ts audio via files.ts getUrl, tests web/test/catalog.test.ts (+ opt-in catalog.live.test.ts, APRICITY_SERVE_URL) in test:flow, design/storage.md §4.1. Verified locally against apricity serve on a migrated copy: 45 samples match the old /api/samples summaries field-for-field (14 Salamander/voice files absent because migrate does not import them; announcer group is now uploads), chop-shop.apr compiles and renders in the browser from the library. BLOCKERS for saving locally: (1) Virtuus virtuus-amplify validation rejects scalar array fields (tags, lastErrors, aliases) on create/update ('Field tags must be a string', lib.rs ~2761 ignores isArray), so Slice updates and saveScore fail; (2) auth.ts getCurrentUser returns null in local mode ('No authenticated user'), so domain.saveScore bails. Upload: clear message, drop zone hidden in cloud. Cloud mode only unit-tested.
